message: Template code must be compatible with C# {0}, but this syntax requires a later version of C#.
title: Template code uses a feature of a C# version later than the template language version.
rationale: The report site (RoslynVersionSyntaxVerifier.OnForbiddenSyntaxUsed) fires on a syntax node that requires a C# version greater than the template language version; the current text does not say that the reported syntax is the problem, and 'must be written in C# 12.0' suggests that exactly this version is required.
